title: Community Labor-Market Rates for Finish Settlements, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Sierra Vista Ranch 1.25; Larkspur Meadows and Willow Bend Reserve 1.12; every other community 1.00. These are the labor-market multipliers of a finish-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, applied to the program's cash-in-lieu maximum in the scheduled finish settlement.

**Rule.** The labor-market multiplier follows the community named on the home's Home Purchase Agreement, the purchase agreement under which Calloway sold the home: Sierra Vista Ranch takes 1.25; Larkspur Meadows or Willow Bend Reserve takes 1.12; any other community takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Community on the Home Purchase Agreement | Labor-market multiplier |
|---|---|
| Sierra Vista Ranch | 1.25 |
| Larkspur Meadows | 1.12 |
| Willow Bend Reserve | 1.12 |
| any other community | 1.00 |

**Points of reading.**
- The community is read from the purchase agreement of the home that carries the coverage, not from where the homeowner lives now or from any other agreement the homeowner holds.
- Hypothetical illustration: a home sold under a Home Purchase Agreement naming Willow Bend Reserve takes 1.12.
